metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-ir[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Record Notes — capture and manage custom-typed notes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bryan can create and update notes of config-declared record types [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](restaurants, podcasts, TV shows, movies) from one capture [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]spelling, `<title> @<dir>/`, with bob guiding every required field.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The same engine powers a `bob records` CLI for agents and a lint [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that keeps every writer honest. The Mac panel shows a Record Card [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and a whole-note preview. Every write is planned in full, never [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]replaces a file, and refuses duplicates.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]13[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]record_notes.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/record_notes.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-ir[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-ir/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture installs new files without ever replacing one[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]no-replace-install[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]no-replace-install: install every newly created capture file with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hard-link no-replace step, so a file that appears mid-commit is refused,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never overwritten.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Records schema, catalog, renderer, and planner[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]records-engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records-engine: add the records config block and its validation, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-folder catalog, the filename rule, the YAML renderer, and the record[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]planner in a new records module, plus the records contract doc.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob records list, show, check, and new[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]records-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after records-engine, no-replace-install[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records-cli: add the bob records command group (list, show, check, new) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with polished output, JSON, shell completion, catalog entries, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]generated CLI docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Restaurant and podcast schemas go live in config and the vault[bold black on #87D7FF][/bold #D7AFFF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]records-vault[dim] · [dim][/dim]after records-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records-vault: add the restaurant and podcast records config through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chezmoi, teach eat.base and podcasts.base the to_try status, point the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]type notes at bob records show, and report the check findings.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture grammar for new records[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]capture-records[dim] · [dim][/dim]after records-engine, no-replace-install[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-records: teach capture the @dir/ and @dir/^stem record items [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with key:: field bullets and dated note bullets, the parse record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]object, dry-run note_files, refusals, the @eat near-miss warning, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-targets record rows.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Guided field entry in capture-complete[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]capture-record-assist[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capture-records[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-record-assist: add the record_field and record_value completion [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contexts with continuations, the next-missing-field request, ranked [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]folder values, record route rows, and the heading-menu New restaurant [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]row that defuses the slash-to-hash rewrite.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add to an existing record with @dir/stem[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]capture-record-append[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capture-record-assist[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-record-append: make @dir/<stem> append dated notes and set [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fields on an existing record as an exact byte-preserving edit, complete [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]existing records after @dir/, turn record_exists into a one-key fix, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add bob records update.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Similar records in capture-related[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]capture-similar-records[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capture-record-append[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-similar-records: extend capture-related so record items get [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]settled same-folder near-title matches with Open, Add to it, and Discard[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]actions.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob records init plus show and movie types[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]records-media-types[dim] · [dim][/dim]after records-vault, capture-record-append[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records-media-types: add bob records init to scaffold a type's folder, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]type note, collection note, and Base, then ship the show (tv/) and movie[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](movies/) types in config and the vault.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac Record Card and guided entry[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]mac-record-card[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capture-record-assist[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-record-card: decode the parse record object and record contexts in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Bob Mac Capture, draw the Record Card in the picker-card slot, wire Tab [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through missing fields and record-aware Return, and style the record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]spans.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  11 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac new-note preview and success line[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]mac-record-preview[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-record-card, capture-records[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-record-preview: render dry-run note_files as a property sheet plus [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]body with a View Markdown disclosure, and show the record success [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]summary.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  12 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac updates, existing-record rows, and Similar records[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-record-revisits[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-record-preview, capture-similar-records[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-record-revisits: present record updates as before-and-after property[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rows, show existing-record completion rows, and extend the Similar band [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to record items with the Add to it action.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  13 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Guide, documentation audit, end-to-end proof, and memory[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]records-wrapup[dim] · [dim][/dim]after records-media-types, mac-record-revisits[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records-wrapup: write the records guide, audit every records doc and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]help page, run an end-to-end walkthrough in a temporary vault, and apply[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the accepted memory decisions.[/#D7D7AF]
